properties.description: The store on the MCP surface (crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/tools.rs, 5 cases): text round-trips and a re-put reports `already_present` rather than looking like new work; NON-UTF-8 BYTES survive the JSON boundary as base64 and come back base64 unchanged, which is the whole reason that field exists; passing both `text` and `base64` is REFUSED rather than resolved by picking one, and passing neither is refused as a mistake rather than stored as an empty blob; `exists` answers false for an unstored hash without erroring, because that is the call someone makes to ask "do I have everything?"; and A SERVER WITH NO --content-path CONFIGURED REFUSES BY NAME instead of inventing a directory — blobs are committed, so where they live is a decision about the consumer's repo.
properties.name: The content store on the MCP surface, including non-UTF-8 bytes
